subject: chickens
one_liner: A spot and derivatives venue for egg-denominated instruments, settled physically, in dozens.
brand_voice_notes: Reads like a mid-tier commodity exchange that filed real paperwork and then discovered its members were birds. Every absurdity is delivered as compliance language: custody, finality, settlement windows, counterparty risk. Never acknowledges the joke. The flock is referred to as 'members'. Eggs are referred to as 'the underlying'. Prices are quoted per dozen with a straight face. No exclamation marks anywhere on the page.

hero.h1: Institutional-grade custody for an asset that breaks.
hero.sub: Clutch operates the only regulated venue where the underlying is laid on-site. Settlement is physical. Delivery is a bird walking somewhere. Fees are quoted in dozens and collected in dozens.

features.title: Cold storage, in the literal sense
features.blurb: Member keys are printed at four point on a paper slip and placed beneath a broody hen. Retrieval requires the hen to stand up of her own accord. Clutch does not hurry the hen. Median withdrawal time is nine days and we consider that a security property.

features.title: Proof of Lay consensus
features.blurb: The ledger advances only when a member lays. Average block time is twenty-six hours and falls to nothing in November. Finality is therefore seasonal, which our counsel has asked us to describe as finality anyway.

features.title: Roost-order authentication
features.blurb: Every dusk the flock sorts itself onto the perch in a stable hierarchy. That sequence is your second factor. Introducing a new bird rotates the credential for the entire pen, a behaviour we have documented and priced rather than fixed.

demo_screen_concept: The Clutch trading floor terminal: a left rail of four tradable instruments (EGG spot, BRWN, BANTAM, DBLYLK-PERP) each with a last price quoted per dozen and a 24h change in dozens; a centre bid/ask ladder with click-to-fill rows and resting orders shown as stacked pulp bars; an order ticket whose buy/sell toggle is labelled SIT and LEAVE, with size entered in dozens and a live estimated settlement date that is always several days out; a depth strip drawn as a moulded carton profile; and a right rail carrying a live Broodiness Index gauge per pen that escalates to a margin call when a member sits on the collateral, plus a settlement log that reads like a barn diary.

images.rationale: Full budget of 4 spent on hero plus three testimonial headshots. Hero earned it: the pulp-carton direction is material rather than purely typographic, and the hero_composition_notes seat a 16:9 photograph inside a moulded cell, so a real bird is the object in the cavity. Demo subject assets skipped because demo_screen_concept is a trading terminal (order ladder, order ticket, depth strip, gauge), which is not photo-shaped and gets CSS treatment instead. Testimonial headshots took the remaining three slots as deadpan directory portraits of the named members.

design_direction.style: Moulded egg-pulp carton with grade-stamp ink, overcast daylight mode. The page is staged as the printed surface of a moulded paper-pulp egg carton produced by a packing plant that also happens to clear derivatives: matte grey-beige fibre, shallow embossed cells, and everything numeric struck on with a rubber date stamp. One light mode only, no dark variant. Explicitly absent, because the previous seven entries used them and this one may not: welded vinyl bladders, valves, chenille patches, engraved brass plates, prismatic or holographic foil, acrylic slabs, vitreous enamel plaques, terrazzo speckle, galvanized zinc panels, hazard chevrons, rivets, pharmaceutical fold creases, blister wells, leaded came, stained glass, gold nimbi, risograph misregistration, halftone dot screens, and knockout ink blocks. Also absent: glassmorphism, backdrop blur, neon, bento lattices, dark mode, and any gradient placed behind body text. Four motifs carry the entire page. (1) The pulp cell: every card, tier, quote and nav pill is a moulded cavity with a 14px corner radius, an inset 2px highlight in #F0EADC along the top and left interior, an inset 2px shade in #A89E88 along the bottom and right interior, and a single hard outer shadow offset 3px down with 4px blur at 14 percent of ink, because pulp is matte and does not float. Nothing on the page has a corner sharper than 6px. (2) The grade stamp: every figure, price, percentage, timestamp, instrument code, tier mark and eyebrow label is struck in Courier Prime with tabular figures inside a 2px indigo frame with 3px corners, rotated -1.2deg, its edges deliberately imperfect via a 1px dashed inner rule, so numbers read as inked onto the carton after moulding rather than printed with it. Stamps never rotate more than 1.5deg and never overlap body text. (3) The fibre field: the page ground is flat #DCD5C4 carrying a fixed, non-animated mottle of four very small repeating radial gradients in #C9C0AB and #EDE7D9 at 5 to 9 percent, dense enough to read as pressed paper at arm's length and never as noise or grain texture. (4) The vent hole: a 7px circle of ground colour with a 1px #A89E88 inner ring, punched in a row at 16px pitch, used as the section divider, the perk bullet, and the marker between metadata fields, the way a carton lid is perforated for air. Section dividers are always a vent row, never a rule. Headings are Fraunces at 700 with its optical and soft axes pushed warm, set sentence case, flush left, tight at -0.015em, its wonky ink traps doing the work a stencil face would do too loudly. Body is Karla at 17px with a 1.62 line-height and a 68-character measure. Colour is rationed hard: the page is pulp and ink almost everywhere, grade-stamp indigo #2F3E8E carries the wordmark, links, stamps and primary CTA fills, and candling vermilion #C0402B appears only on the Broodiness Index, the single highlighted fee tier, and downside figures, so risk is the only warm thing on the page. Icons are inline SVG at a uniform 1.6px round-capped stroke, never filled, never emoji. Motion is stamping: cells press to translateY 1px with their shadow tightening to 1px on press and restoring on release, stamps ink up from opacity 0.82 to 1 on hover with no movement, cells rise in on reveal from translateY 8px and opacity 0, the index gauge fills once on entering the viewport and holds, all on 180ms ease-out and all gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

design_direction.archetype: Regulated commodity and crypto exchange landing page on the trust-and-authority pattern: CTA above the fold, a full-bleed member photograph in the hero, three custody capability cells, three member testimonials as moulded cells with portrait stamps, a three-cell fee schedule with the middle tier raised, and a closing handoff cell to the trading floor terminal. Composed as packing-plant literature rather than fintech marketing.
design_direction.motion_vocab: Stamping and pressing. Nothing slides, nothing glows, nothing blurs. Cells depress 1px under the cursor and their shadow tightens. Ink saturates instead of elements moving. One gauge fill, once, on reveal. Everything 180ms ease-out and everything behind prefers-reduced-motion.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Left column carries the wordmark stamp, a monumental Fraunces claim at clamp(2.6rem, 6.2vw, 4.6rem), a 66-character subhead in Karla, the primary CTA as an indigo-filled cell with a vermilion secondary link beside it, and a four-field metadata stamp row (VENUE / UNDERLYING / SETTLEMENT / LOT) separated by vent holes. Right column is the hero photograph inset in a pulp cell with the emboss rims visible, 16:9, never full-bleed to the viewport edge, so the bird reads as an item seated in a carton cavity. Below the fold both columns collapse to one at 860px, photograph second.
